title: Perspire Sauna Studio

services.name: Infrared Sauna
services.desc: Your private sauna suite is prepared with your personal preferences in mind - from temperature to lighting - creating an environment designed to reduce stress and support relaxation. Get ready to feel better than when you arrived. Show up hydrated, bring water, and arrive 15 minutes early to check in for your session. Wear what’s comfortable-towels are provided. As core temperature rises, sweating begins within 10-20 minutes. Adjust your temperature settingsfor comfort, activate red light therapy, and unwind with your private, in-suite TV. Your natural cool down continues after your session. Enjoy a cold eucalyptus towel to reinvigorate your skin, and rehydrate with water and electrolytes

services.name: Contrast Therapy
services.desc: Introducing SNØ Showers, our proprietary and hygienic take on contrast therapy. Designed to help reduce inflammation, elevate mood, and support deeper recovery with every session. A repeatable ritual that’s uniquely yours. Powered by Silient™ cold-water chiller technology and with an emphasis on safety and customization, our in-suite SNØ showers are innovatively designed to integrate seamlessly into the sauna experience. The combination of full spectrum infrared sauna, red light therapy, and SNØ showers offers a powerful blend of physical and mental benefits.
